summary: @servicetitan/kendo-theme preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package presents itself as a Kendo UI CSS theme (main: dist/index.css) but its package.json declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs constructs a URL under github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/, downloads the Bun runtime to a temp directory, chmod +x's it, and then execFileSync's the downloaded Bun binary against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB Bun CJS bundle with rotated string-array obfuscation (a decoder function shift-rotates a large mixed numeric/string array used as a lookup table) and mangled identifiers. A CSS theme has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time in order to execute an obfuscated bundle; the bundle's behavior is not inspectable by Node-based scanners because it is executed under a separately downloaded Bun interpreter. On `npm install`, this delivers arbitrary attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's machine under the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
